notes: Proof consumes ui_diagnostics() when a production module implements it.
Proof does not add that method and does not synthesize a stand-in HUD.
Viewport and region rects are logical UI viewport units from get_viewport_rect / get_global_rect.
PNG and window pixels are recorded separately with the measured canvas/window transform.
Inner essential controls use a 2px margin. The root dock may sit flush.
Hidden regions (visible false) do not fail READY bounds.
sample_hz is the harness sample interval, not a guessed UI rate.
target quality is not claimed from this baseline.
